public_evidence.student_action: Decomposed two vertical architectural slices into 4 highly prescriptive, AI-executable engineering tickets.

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the candidate can translate architecture into rigorous, executable tickets that guarantee secure, production-grade output—even when delegated to automated agents.
